svg.title: Cruise: a flight route
svg.desc: A route crosses the sky. Each dot is a prompt and the aircraft's height is the reasoning effort picked for it, never above a ceiling. A fuel gauge shows the context filling up; at 80% the aircraft lands at a handoff stop, hands over handoff.md, and a new aircraft with a full tank takes off from the same point. A line at the bottom says what is happening now, what is done and what is next.
svg.text: Each dot is a prompt. Height is the effort the judge picks for it.
